name: off-oversized-output-rollover-no-credentials
description: official-host.ts:658 'oversized tool output rolls over without credentials and repeated resets do not nest recovery'. A tool returns a 600,000-char result plus an image; posthorse answers the threshold compaction with a recovery record that names the image ('[1 image: image/png] - recover with history read id ...') and carries no image bytes; the next request holds only that record; a history read of the dump's entry id (saved from get_entries while the model's request is held) returns the image again. A second cycle in the same session must not nest the first record ('Earlier automatic records skipped'). No summarization request is made (6 requests for 2 cycles).
